summary: The root "lwdh" primarily means to seek refuge, protection, or aid from someone or something. It also describes something encompassing or surrounding another, like a road around a house.
lane: 1 لَاذَ بِهِ ذ , aor. يَلُوذُ , (S, A, L, Msb,) inf. n. لَوْذٌ (S, L, K) and لِيَاذٌ (S, A, L, K) and لِوَاذٌ (L, Msb, K) and لَوَاذٌ and لُوَاذٌ , (Msb, K,) He had recourse to it, (a mountain [&c.], Msb,) or him, for refuge or protection or preservation; (S, A, L, Msb;) as also به , inf. n. لِوَاذٌ ; (A;) and به ; (Msb;) sought, or took, refuge in it, or him; (S, L;) and joined himself to him; and sought, desired, implored, or called for, aid, or succour, of him: (L:) he protected, concealed, defended, or fortified himself by it, (L, K,) or him; (L;) as also به , (L,) inf. n. مُلَاوَذَةٌ (L, K) and لِوَاذٌ ; (L;) and . (L.) -b2- لَاذَ بِهِ , (L,) inf. n. as above, in the commencement of the art., (K,) It encompassed, or surrounded, it; (L, K; *) as also , (L,) inf. n. إِلَاذَةٌ . (L, K.) You say, لَاذَ الطَّرِيقُ بِالدَّارِ , and , The road encompassed, or surrounded, the house: (L:) or, reached, or extended, to the house: (Msb:) and لَاذَتِ الدَّارُ بِالطَّرِيقِ The house encompassed, or surrounded, the road. (L.) See also 3. -b3- لَاذَ بِالقَوْمِ and بِهِم , He laboured, or strove, to overcome the people in any way; expl. by the words هى المداورة من حيث ماكان . (T, L.) [Perhaps المداورة is a mistake for المُدَارَاة ; see 3: the same phrases being explained in the M by دَاَراهُمْ : but there is a near resemblance between the significations of المداورة and المداراة .]

headwords.def: لَا َ بِهِ, aor. يَلُو ُ, (S, A, L, Msb,) inf. n. لَوْ ٌ (S, L, K) and لِيَا ٌ (S, A, L, K) and لِوَا ٌ (L, Msb, K) and لَوَا ٌ and لُوَا ٌ, (Msb, K,) He had recourse to it, (a mountain [&c.], Msb,) or him, for refuge or protection or preservation; (S, A, L, Msb;) as also به, inf. n.

لاو القَوْمُ, (S, L,) inf. n. مُلَاوَ َةٌ and لِوَا ٌ, (S, L, K,) with which تَلْوَا ٌ is syn., (K,) The people had recourse, one to another, for refuge or protection or preservation; sought, or took, refuge, one in another; protected, concealed, defended, or fortified, themselves, one by another. (S, L, K. *) Agreeably with this explanation, (as some say, L,) لِوَا ًا is used in the Kur, xxiv. 63: were it from لَا َ, it would be لِيَا ًا. (S, L.) See 1. لاو بِهِمْ, inf. n.

أَلْوَ َ see 1: and 3. الا بِهِ غَيْرَهُ [ He caused another to have recourse to him or it for refuge or protection or preservation; to seek, or take, refuge in him or it; to protect, conceal, defend, or fortify, himself by him or it: or he protected, concealed, defended, or fortified, another by means of him or it ]. (A.) الا ت النَّاقَةُ الظِّلَّ بِخُفِّهَا (tropical:) [ The she-camel covered, or concealed, the shade with her foot ]; meaning that the time of noonday-heat was come. (A.)

لَوْ ٌ The side of a mountain; and its circuit: pl. ألْوَا ٌ. (S, A, L, K.) A side, or lateral part or tract, of a country or region: (A:) and of a thing; (TA;) as also: (K:) pl. as above. (A.) A place of bending of a valley: pl. as above. (L, K.) هُوَ بِلَوْ ِ كَ َا, and كَ َا, He, or it, is in the side of, or part adjacent to, such a place or thing. (L.) هُوَ لَوْ َهُ He is near to him or it. (L.)
لَوْ َانِيَّةٌ, (as in some copies of the K,) or لَوَ َانِيَّةٌ, (as in others and in the TA,) Circumvention; delusion; syn. مُرَاوَغَةٌ. (K.) See 3.

مَلَا ٌ and [the latter thus in the K and accord. to the TA; but in the TT, مَلْوَ َة; and in the L, without the first vowel-sign;] A place to which one has recourse for refuge, protection, preservation, or concealment; a place of refuge; a refuge; (TA;) a fortress; a fortified place; a castle. (L, K.)

خَيْرٌ مُلَاوِ ٌ (tropical:) Little good: (S:) or good that comes not save after severe toil or labour: occurring in a verse of El-Katámee: you say, خَيْرُ بَنِى فُلَانٍ مُلَاوِ ٌ The good of the sons of such a one comes not save after severe toil or trouble to procure it. (ISk, T, L.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
